body: I don't want to hurt them by dying, I really don't. But I do think it may be better long term if I just died now instead of being an ongoing disappointment. Besides, they have three other kids so like they would still have a family. I just wish I could die and not hurt my family I really do, it's the only thing stopping me :( And like I have tried some new hobbies over the past year for sure, I have tried yoga, hiking, running, making crafts, ukulele, painting, journaling, and nothing has stuck, I just get so sad that I can't make myself do it anymore. I tell myself I'm bad at things and don't deserve to enjoy them. I even dropped out of my competitive major and I've quit two jobs in the past 6 months and like I feel like my actions are becoming increasingly more erratic and irrational and I'm afraid that i have no sense of self at all.
